recipe.visualDefinition: A three-panel vertical triptych featuring three female vocalists in metallic silver attire, separated by industrial metal bars. The central figure is framed by a foreground graphic device consisting of a stylized, organic cyan shape and bold, italicized sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division of space using architectural elements as frames
Contrast between warm skin tones and cool metallic/cyan accents
Layering of bold vector graphics over photographic depth
Symmetry created by flanking figures looking toward the center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in medium close-up; central subject is slightly larger and more forward-facing.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cyan graphic 'X' or splash shape in the lower third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central face, move down to the bold text, then outward to the flanking figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures and graphic overlays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and skin tones (background and subjects)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and deep teal (typography and graphic device)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the photography; high saturation in the cyan graphic elements.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers treated with the same weight and slant as letters
Sub-text is outlined or high-contrast white against the cyan background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with weight and style variations (solid vs. outlined).
graphicDevices: Organic, blob-like 'X' shape with cyan gradient
Thin horizontal rule line intersecting the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed-yet-bold feel.
Captures the Y2K tech-pop aesthetic perfectly.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a triptych of three women in metallic silver tops. The central woman is behind vertical metal bars, looking forward. The two side women are in separate vertical panels, looking inward. Soft, warm studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, organic cyan-to-blue gradient splash shape in the lower third. Over this, place two lines of bold, italicized sans-serif text. The top line should be black with a cyan outline; the bottom line should be white.

verificationChecks: Is the triptych clearly divided by vertical lines?
Does the cyan graphic have a smooth gradient?
Is the text heavily italicized and bold?
Are the subjects wearing reflective silver clothing?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the models
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the cyan splash.
Ensure the vertical bars align with the panel divisions.
Verify the metallic sheen on the clothing is prominent.
Confirm the italic angle is consistent across all text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Triptych photography + Industrial framing + Bold Y2K italicized typography + Cyan gradient vector overlays.
